claim_boundary: Pepforge provides design, conformer generation, local geometry/contact screening, simulation-protocol planning, and static structure review. Production MD and trajectory analysis are reserved for V5. It does not claim validated affinity/Kd/Delta G or experimental efficacy.
patch_notes: SPPS Planner V5.0.0 Public/Data-Sanitized logic is integrated while LOT Number and Batch Manager remain excluded from the Pepforge operator surface.
The V5 Cys cleavage-equivalent rule is synchronized across the engine/advisor path: manual override first; otherwise 100 TFA eq per Cys with no peptide-length addition.
Fake or surrogate scientific outputs are blocked or explicitly classified.
Modified peptide chemistry is preserved through structure and docking preparation.
PDE uses user-provided labeled data only for trained-model reranking.
SPPS and Hot Spot workflows retain native desktop operation and explicit progress.
SPPS V5 advice applies only coherent reviewed historical conditions; it does not invent an optimum or merge records.
LOT Number and Batch Manager are excluded from the Pepforge SPPS surface.
Latest SPPS V5 Public decision-support workflow is synchronized without private experimental seed data.
Exact cleavage cocktails are reproduced only from one complete reviewed compatible historical record; generic guidance cannot fabricate exact Apply conditions.
PDE uses actual Pareto NSGA-II selection with chemistry-aware final diversity and stable candidate manifests.

PSB follows explicit PDE structure intent inside the requested geometry basin, prioritizes severe-clash-free requested-family backbone geometry, and treats RMSD/family spread as diagnostics rather than a diversity selection target.
PDE supports Interaction Only, Interaction First, Balanced, Structure Guided, and Structure Exploration modes.
Result-bundle naming and packaging are centralized to prevent scattered outputs and Windows-invalid names.

Structure-consensus comparison requires exact peptide sequence identity and reports CA/backbone RMSD, Rg, DSSP agreement, per-residue displacement, and steric diagnostics without treating an external predictor as ground truth.
External MD summary import remains UNSCORED; nominal duration or a single RMSD/contact threshold is not converted into an A/B/C/D convergence grade.

PDE exports simulation-readiness, initial-state sensitivity, force-field sensitivity, membrane-interface experimental descriptors, and beta-hairpin evidence without adding fake simulation outcomes to Interaction Only.
Workflow Mode normalizes PDE pde_objective_mode into downstream PSB mode and preserves one unique PDE candidate ID for the same construct.
Candidate Summary Reports index only artifacts that actually exist; absent Docking, trajectory, and experimental stages remain unavailable.
Beta-hairpin/turn-rich requests do not receive invented exact torsion templates; coiled-coil remains monomeric preorganization only; Pro-rich PPII is reclassified from measured relaxed geometry.
PDE Conformational Strategy (PREORGANIZED/ADAPTIVE/FLEXIBLE) is an optimizer policy with explicit claim guards.
Structure evidence is family-specific: Pace-Scholtz alpha context, refined PPII context, beta-face/edge evidence, explicit Aib and dP-G/Aib-G motif-guided search.
PSB beta-hairpin detection evaluates relaxed turn geometry and bidirectional nonlocal backbone contacts rather than trusting seed labels.
Hotspot Complementarity is coarse chemistry evidence with OFF/REPORT_ONLY/EVIDENCE_AND_SELECTION modes; it is not docking, affinity, or free-energy prediction.
SPPS V5 FAST_OPEN keeps repeated experimental-data reads on an initialized-DB fast path while persisting schema/backfill metadata.
Loading/cleavage/outcome/issue records created from one active Project Manager work item share traceable run_id/work_item_id values.
Docking Workbench exports a separate conservative-manual/tool-compatible specific-interaction evidence table; the existing coarse contact table remains backward compatible.
Workflow Mode exports a weighted Hot Spot chemistry profile and passes it to PDE as sequence-composition evidence, never as a 3D contact or affinity claim.
Modified-peptide support is reported by PDE/PSB/SPPS/Docking-export/MD stage rather than as a blanket support claim.
Structure Consensus v2 reports local backbone displacement, nonlocal CA contact-map agreement and optional hotspot-region RMSD without treating external models as ground truth.
V4 prepares candidate -> PSB -> future docking lineage plus a PyMOL review script only; actual docking execution remains a future V5 scope.
Candidate comparison keeps evidence axes separate and does not generate an aggregate binding/affinity/confidence score.
Production-source release audit reports zero runtime monkey-patch, placeholder/dummy, pass-only, NotImplemented-only, and duplicate-definition findings.
Final Polish RC1 keeps evidence roles and dependencies visible, exports blind-review mappings separately, and does not collapse heterogeneous evidence into a winner score.
SPPS literature aggregation evidence now resolves the embedded parser through a package-safe path when Candidate Summary or CLI code runs before the GUI bootstrap.
The empty runtime workspace/external/outputs directory is excluded from the clean package so release integrity, verification matrix, and release gate artifact checks remain clean.
R6 Docking remapping preserves D/non-natural residue identity and keeps modifiers/linkers from consuming peptide residue numbering.
R6 Workflow state uses a PDE revision lineage so unchanged candidate IDs cannot reuse PSB/SPPS outputs from an earlier PDE configuration.

The complete R6 regression collection contains 411 test outcomes: 410 passed, 1 intentional skip, and 0 failures in the validated development tree; exact fresh-unzip validation is recorded in the companion R6 validation report.

R8 restored Workflow/SPPS sequence persistence, authoritative resin loading defaults, direct-loading gating, Workflow PDE length controls, Workflow-to-SPPS handoff, and conservative Docking specific-interaction review.
R9 routes embedded SPPS Loading/Cleavage/Outcome/Issue reads and writes through the initialized persistent experimental database instead of allowing uninitialized paths to look empty.
R9 preserves TFA/Water/TIS cleavage context from persisted selected-cleavage rows when the visible cleavage table is not populated.
R9 makes experimental database initialization and Result/Issue save failures explicit to the operator rather than presenting an empty history or closing a dialog as if a save succeeded.
R9 filters shared Loading recommendation query extras before calling the narrower legacy-compatible observed-condition API while retaining bounded target-inversion context.
R9 includes a two-process regression: Verified Loading/Cleavage evidence is written, the process exits, the same SQLite store is reopened, and both persistence and advisor reuse are verified.
The complete R9 development-tree regression collection contains 438 test outcomes: 437 passed, 1 intentional Public-only skip, and 0 failures; direct Release Gate reports 25 passed / 0 failed.
R10 fixes the reported Windows SPPS launch failure caused by startup diagnostics assuming a log_text widget exists; messages now buffer safely when the streamlined Log tab is absent.
R10 adds MSDS/SDS lookup buttons to SPPS Planner and PDE. They open an explicit Google SDS/MSDS query in the user default browser and do not scrape, cache, or certify safety data.

SPPS lookup prefers the selected Materials/Plan/Cleavage chemistry; PDE lookup uses explicit design chemistry tokens and does not guess a protected SPPS bottle identity from natural one-letter residues.
R12 makes the visible Project Manager pm_sequence authoritative for Generate/Apply and mirrors non-empty values into legacy seq state before calculation.
R12 preserves an intentionally blank visible Sequence instead of resurrecting stale saved/legacy sequence state.
R12 regression reproduces GHK / 1000 mmol / 2-CTC / DIC-HOBt with a deliberately blank legacy seq and validates both canonical and classic Generate routes.
R13 treats an empty visible Project Manager Sequence as a valid idle/startup state for automatic output refresh; no implicit parser call is made until a visible sequence exists.
R13 keeps R12 source-of-truth semantics: pm_sequence wins over stale legacy seq, while explicit Generate/Apply continue to validate missing sequence input.
R14 writes peptide SEQRES plus exact Pepforge modified-construct metadata into PSB PDB exports while preserving residue-aware ATOM/HETATM coordinates.
R14 Docking Workbench recovers peptide identity from Pepforge exact-sequence metadata, then SEQRES, then ATOM/HETATM residue extraction.
R14 keeps modifiers/linkers outside peptide residue numbering and does not fabricate coordinates for ambiguous unsupported derivatives.
R14 GitHub-ready packaging excludes runtime workspace/log artifacts and preserves the public data boundary.
